services.name: School Tours
services.desc: The Meux Home Museum offers an unforgettable educational experience for students of all ages, from younger children to high school students. Our tours are designed to engage and inspire, providing a deep dive into Victorian history and daily life. Whether you’re seeking a general introduction to the museum’s rich history or an immersive, hands-on lesson about life in the 1880s, our tours cater to the curiosity and learning needs of students. Many residents of Fresno fondly remember visiting the Meux Home when they were younger, and we are excited to continue that tradition by welcoming the next generation of learners.
